messages:
Mike (PR): Heads-up: small analyst + press briefing for the benchmark post next Wed. Need embargo logistics, final quote, and a 1-pager. Who owns what?
Sara (Comms): I can own invite list + checklist. Need final quote by EOD Mon.
Jin (Product): I’ll do a 10m demo. What are the key metrics to highlight?
Eddie (Eng): p95 latency and cost-per-inference deltas. Will prepare numbers and config.
Mike (PR): Draft quote — please shorten/edit:
"Redwood Inference reduces 95th percentile latency by 2.3x and lowers per-inference cost by 40%, enabling teams to ship low-latency experiences." — Jin
Sara (Comms): Too long. Suggest: "Redwood Inference cuts p95 latency and per-inference cost, letting teams deliver fast, affordable LLM features." — Jin?
Jin (Product): Fine. Change to "per-inference" for clarity.
Laura (Legal): Legal note: add "in our internal tests" and attach test config/dataset. Also confirm embargo window. No competitor name calls.
Mike (PR): Proposed embargo 10 AM PT Thurs. OK?
Laura (Legal): OK. Route embargo notices to legal@redwood + PR. No leaks to partners before embargo.
Olga (BD): Analyst targets: TG Research, Eastbridge, Atlas. Recommend pre-briefs with TG + Eastbridge day before.
Sara (Comms): Pre-briefs = off-the-record unless they request otherwise.
Mike (PR): Action items:
- Sara: assemble invite list & send briefing invite
- Jin/Eddie: finalize quote + attach test config
- Laura: legal signoff on wording + embargo confirm
- Olga: analyst list & pre-brief schedule
- Mike: press kit + media Q&A
press-bot: Calendar invites sent: Briefing 2026-03-26 17:00 UTC; Pre-briefs 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Sara (Comms): Draft press kit link: https://docs.internal/redwood/benchmarks/briefing-draft — please comment.
Eddie (Eng): Test config snippet for kit:
```
Model: redwood-v1-13B
Seq len: 1024
Batching: dynamic (avg 6)
p95: 124ms vs baseline 287ms
Cost/inference: $0.012 vs $0.020 (-40%)
```
Jin (Product): Approved short quote with qualifier: "In our internal tests, Redwood Inference cut p95 latency and per-inference cost, letting teams deliver fast, affordable LLM features." — Jin
Laura (Legal): Approved with tweak: include "in our internal tests" near the verb.
Mike (PR): Updated quote in press kit. Please proof/comment by EOD Mon. If no major flags we'll lock assets Wed morning and distribute embargoed.
Sara (Comms): I'll route inbound press to pr@redwood and set up shared mailbox for analysts.
Olga (BD): Sending analyst invites now; marking pre-briefs off-the-record where requested.
Mike (PR): Reminder: blur customer IDs and redact internal hostnames on screenshots.
Eddie (Eng): Will sanitize screenshots and upload final numbers.
press-bot: Document snapshot saved.
Sara (Comms): One last: need a 2-line TL;DR for release.
Jin (Product): TL;DR: "Redwood Inference cuts p95 latency and per-inference cost in our internal tests, unlocking faster, cheaper LLM features for engineers."
Laura (Legal): Final reminder: embargo enforced until 10 AM PT Thurs. No early outreach.
Mike (PR): Locking thread; ping Sara or me for urgent items. :thumbsup:
